observations.behavior: Adds Redis-backed state and a new, Redis-backed MismatchTracker, replacing the previous in-memory-only tracker. The tracker now persists its pending mismatch state in Redis, allowing it to survive process restarts and survive toolchain bumps.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a critical reliability and compatibility improvement. The previous implementation used std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher, which does not promise stable output across Rust versions. This change switches to SHA-256, which is stable across toolchain versions, and persists the fingerprint in Redis. This prevents a toolchain bump from changing every fingerprint and demot
